prompt:
Create a transparent-background pixel-art atlas exactly TWO equal square cells side-by-side: TOP then REAR of the same wooden trophy shelf. The attached labeled source and accepted FRONT/RIGHT/LEFT/BOTTOM are the sole identity/layout authority. Keep top-level item count exactly THREE: hanging green plant, one gold trophy cup, one framed photo. The small gold ornament belongs on the lower shelf and must remain fully occluded in both projections. Orthographic views, no perspective.

TOP: camera straight down. Shelf is upright against a wall, and its framed photo is also standing tilted upright, NOT lying flat on the shelf. Therefore show only the thin top edge/cap of its frame and a narrow stand wedge, NEVER the rectangular picture face. Show the plant canopy/leaf cap and the circular rim opening of the single gold cup. Do not add the small gold lower-shelf object anywhere on the top board.
REAR: show plain wood backboard and the rear backs/stands of the same plant, cup and photo frame at source positions. Do NOT show a front picture face. The lower-shelf small gold ornament is completely occluded by the board and must not appear at the left or anywhere above the rear panel. Only these three top objects may project over the top/back edge.
Keep full shelf width, source wood tone and gold hardware. Center each view with transparent margin. No labels/shadows, no stray pixels, no extra objects or clipped silhouettes; crisp pixel art.
